title: Validation engine and CI gate for Mermaid diagrams
description: Shared engine under skills/diagram-review/scripts: mermaid-check.mjs pinned to GitHub's Mermaid, diagram_lint.py for the profile and level rules, pytest coverage, and a CI workflow that runs the parse check, lint, pytest and lore check, with a self-test proving the gate fails on broken diagrams and passes on fixed ones.

acceptanceCriteria.text: mermaid-check.mjs pinned to mermaid 11.17.2 exits 1 on every fixture under tests/fixtures/mermaid/fail and 0 on every fixture under tests/fixtures/mermaid/pass
diagram_lint.py enforces quoted labels, banned ids, accTitle/accDescr, the level node cap, and an explanation next to the fence, with pytest coverage
CI runs the parse check over docs/ and skills/, the fail/pass self-test, the lint, pytest and lore check on every pull request
The gate is shown red on a pull-request commit carrying a broken diagram and green after the fix, with both run URLs recorded on this task

plan: 1. Promote the lab parse checker into skills/diagram-review/scripts with pinned package.json and lockfile
4. CI workflow: npm ci, parse docs+skills, self-test, lint, pytest, lore check
5. Prove the gate red then green on the PR
implementationNotes: Local evidence: tests/mermaid_selftest.sh OK (28 pass fixtures exit 0; 12/12 fail fixtures syntax-error; fail dir exit 1; markdown with one broken fence exit 1). diagram_lint.py: 19 pytest tests pass (py3.9 and 3.12). Fence regex tightened so mermaid-broken/text fences can show bad examples.

Gate proven both ways on PR #5: RED run https://github.com/opum-ai/diagram-skills/actions/runs/37368998996 on ae16759 failed at 'Parse every Mermaid diagram' (docs/stories/validation-engine-and-ci-gate.md:45, unquoted label); GREEN run https://github.com/opum-ai/diagram-skills/actions/runs/37498971774 on d5dcf6e passed both jobs (diagram gate incl. self-test, lint, pytest; lore check). Two earlier runs were cancelled by GitHub's hosted-runner incident ('job was not acquired by Runner of type hosted'), not by the gate.
finalSummary: Mermaid validation engine and CI gate: mermaid-check.mjs (mermaid 11.17.2 + jsdom, fence-aware), diagram_lint.py (profile, a11y, level caps, legend, explanation; 22 tests), tests/mermaid_selftest.sh, .github/workflows/ci.yml. PR #5; proven red on ae16759 (run 37368998996) and green on d5dcf6e (run 37498971774).
